text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zimbabwe press on Friday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Ministry of Defence plans to purchase eight aircraft for the Air Force to replace its ageing fleet, defence minister Moven Mahachi said on Thursday.

- About 7,000 civil servants who bought shares in the Public Service Association Investment Trust Company in 1990 have not realised a dividend from their investments and there are fears that millions invested may never be recovered.
- The general manager of a private Zimbabwean security company shot 18 striking guards on Thursday, seriously wounding one of them.
- President Robert Mugabe says his government will not rush to sell its remaining stake in national dairy Dairibord.
